title: should save a builder chart as a Saved View and restore it in full when applied
verifies: a build-mode view saved with a non-default area chart restores the area chart type, builder mode, and x/y layouts when applied after the build tab was already visited

title: Custom-SQL (customQuery) saved view restores Custom mode, table chart and the saved SQL
verifies: a build-mode view saved with customQuery=true restores Custom-SQL mode, the table chart, and the saved SQL verbatim

title: toggling away and back does not re-apply the saved chart (one-shot consumption)
verifies: savedBuildConfig is consumed once — a later toggle back to Build re-derives the default bar chart instead of re-applying the saved area chart

title: applying a view with no buildData falls back to defaults without crashing
verifies: a view saved in Logs mode (no buildData) applies without error and the Build tab falls back to default builder mode

title: a saved view wins over a stale URL build_data
verifies: applying a saved view overrides a stale bar build_data in the URL and restores the saved area chart
